story.about: A fragile ivory origami boat sails an ocean born from a blank desk, surviving a tidal wave to reveal AutoPromote’s power in transforming the mundane into the monumental
story.whyCare: Founders need to see how their tools can turn small ideas into vast, scalable realities — visually, emotionally, and physically convincing
story.hook: A paper boat on a desk becomes an ocean — and survives a tsunami
story.beginning: An empty wooden desk under soft overhead light. A single folded ivory origami boat rests center-frame. The camera slowly pulls back as the surface beneath it begins to ripple like water, deepening to cobalt blue
story.development: The boat drifts across the newly formed ocean. Camera glides low, tracking its movement. Suddenly, a towering wall of churning water curls toward it — the boat remains untouched, intact
story.tension: The wave crashes inches from the boat. Water splashes violently around it, but the origami holds. The camera tilts upward as the wave recedes, revealing golden sunlight breaking through clouds
story.payoff: The boat glides into calm, shimmering waters. The camera rises to a distant aerial view — the boat occupies less than 15% of the frame, dwarfed by the ocean. Then, the screen fades to black, followed by the AutoPromote logo
story.ending: White text animates on a dark background: 'AutoPromote — Where Ideas Become Oceans'. Amber accents pulse gently around the letters
story.withheld: The brand name is withheld until the final identity card
